scope: ATP 2017-2024 priced primary cohort (n 18,882) and WTA 2025-2026 priced primary cohort (n 2,344): saved P0/P1/full_tier, WTA base/full and market forecasts rescored; a new descriptive rung, probability-pooled tour-level Elo read from the saved feature table, scored on the same cohorts for the first time (ATP 0.6237, WTA 0.6265 match-weighted log loss).
